title: Analysis of miRNAs in Human Melanoma Cells
author: Lattmann, Guggiari, et al.
materials: RNAscope Plus smRNA-RNA HD reagent kit

steps.title: Prepare RPMI culture medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 % sodium pyruvate (1 mM), 2 % L‑glutamine (4 mM) and 10 % heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum to RPMI‑1640, mix well, then sterile‑filter through a 0.22 µm PES membrane using a vacuum pump; store at 4 °C up to 2 months. No antibiotics are added.

steps.title: Seed cells for assay
steps.instruction: One day before the assay, seed cells to reach ~80 % confluency: for T75 flasks seed enough cells to be ~80 % confluent the next day; for 4‑well culture slides plate 200 000 cells per chamber.

steps.title: Detach, count, and plate cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium, wash cells with 1× PBS, detach with 1 mL 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA, resuspend in 5 mL RPMI, transfer to a 15 mL centrifuge tube, centrifuge at 300 g for 3 min at 22 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 2 mL medium, count cells, then (a) plate ¼–½ of the cells into a fresh T75 flask, or (b) plate 200 000 cells per chamber of a 4‑well slide and add RPMI to a final volume of 800 µL per chamber.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium and wash with 1× PBS
Resuspend in 5 mL RPMI and transfer to 15 mL tube
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in 2 mL medium
Plate cells as described for flasks or 4‑well slides

steps.title: Prepare 4 % paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Break open a glass ampule of 16 % PFA, transfer the liquid to a 15 mL tube, dilute 1 volume 16 % PFA with 3 volumes PBS (e.g., 1 mL PFA + 3 mL PBS) to obtain 4 % PFA; use immediately (≈400 µL per cell‑line sample) and store any unused solution at –20 °C.

steps.title: Make target probe mix
steps.instruction: Spin down RNAscope Probes C2, C3 and C4. Add ~7–10 drops (≈100 µL) of the S1 miRNA probe (or Probe Diluent if miRNA detection is not required) to a 1.5 mL tube. Pipette 50 µL of S1 and 1 µL each of C2, C3 and C4 (50:1:1:1 ratio) – for a single slide this corresponds to 100 µL S1 and 2 µL each of C2‑C4 – and mix by gentle inversion. If only one of C2‑C4 is used, dilute that probe with Probe Diluent. Prepare 50–100 µL of mix per slide; a master mix can be made for multiple slides. Store the mixed probes at 2–8 °C for up to six months.

steps.title: Dilute TSA fluorophores
steps.instruction: Dilute each selected TSA Vivid/Opal fluorophore 1:750–1:3000 in the TSA Buffer supplied with the RNAscope Plus HD Reagent Kit; the assay described used a 1:1500 dilution.

steps.title: Prepare 1× RNAscope wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 60 mL of 50× RNAscope Wash Buffer to 2.94 L distilled water to make 3 L of 1× Wash Buffer; mix well. If precipitation occurs in the 50× stock, warm it at 40 °C for 10–20 min before dilution. Store the 1× buffer at 20–25 °C for up to one month.
